# Ruby gem dependencies for lkp-deps.sh
# =======================================
#
# One gem per line. Lines starting with # are comments, blank lines are
# ignored. A version (or any other gem-install flag) can be pinned by adding
# it after the gem name, e.g.:
#
#   bundler -v 2.5.19
#
# To add a new gem dependency, just add a new line below.

text-table
activesupport -v 6.0.0
bigdecimal
json
racc
parser
tins
term-ansicolor
rubocop-ast
rubocop
flex
bundler -v 2.5.19

# NOTE: don't add an unpinned "git" gem here. lkp-tests' own Gemfile pins
# "git" to "~> 1.7.0" and `bundle install` (run separately by lkp-tests
# itself during `lkp install`) already installs that version into this same
# shared gem path. Installing a second, newer "git" gem (e.g. latest from
# rubygems.org) here makes Ruby's non-bundler-scoped `require 'git'` (used
# by `lkp split-job` and friends) resolve to the newest installed version
# instead, which can be ABI/API-incompatible with lkp-tests' own vendored
# lib/git.rb and crash with "Base is not a class (TypeError)" or similar.
